note: Udvalgte udgivelses- og premieredatoer fra Love Thy Nerds kalender (ca. 1.150 poster i alt). Her er de, der stadig bliver husket. Posterne uden egen forklaring faar én af deres medium.

days.name: A Christmas Carol
days.why_da: Dickens skrev den på seks uger og udgav den selv, fordi forlaget ikke troede på den.
days.why_en: Dickens wrote it in six weeks and published it himself, because the publisher did not believe in it.

days.name: Oreo
days.why_da: Den første blev solgt til en købmand i Hoboken, New Jersey. Mønstret på kiksen er ændret fire gange siden.
days.why_en: The first ones were sold to a grocer in Hoboken, New Jersey. The pattern on the wafer has changed four times since.

days.name: Hobbitten
days.why_da: Tolkien skrev første sætning på bagsiden af en eksamensopgave, han var ved at rette.
days.why_en: Tolkien wrote the first sentence on the back of an exam paper he was marking.

days.name: Superman
days.why_da: Action Comics #1. Siegel og Shuster solgte figuren for 130 dollars.
days.why_en: Action Comics #1. Siegel and Shuster sold the character for $130.

days.name: Play-Doh
days.why_da: Det blev opfundet som tapetrens og solgte skidt, indtil nogen opdagede, at børn kunne lege med det.
days.why_en: It was invented as wallpaper cleaner and sold badly until somebody noticed children could play with it.

days.name: Radiserne
days.why_da: Schulz tegnede hver enkelt stribe selv i knap 50 år — 17.897 i alt. Den sidste udkom dagen efter hans død.
days.why_en: Schulz drew every single strip himself for nearly 50 years — 17,897 of them. The last appeared the day after he died.

days.name: Fantastic Four #1
days.why_da: Marvels begyndelse. Lee og Kirby fik frie hænder, fordi serien alligevel skulle have været den sidste.
days.why_en: The beginning of Marvel. Lee and Kirby were given free rein because the title was meant to be their last anyway.

days.name: G.I. Joe
days.why_da: Hasbro turde ikke kalde den en dukke, så de opfandt ordet „action figure“.
days.why_en: Hasbro dared not call it a doll, so they invented the phrase “action figure”.

days.name: Spider-Man
days.why_da: Amazing Fantasy #15 — bladets sidste nummer. Han var kun med, fordi det var ved at blive lukket.
days.why_en: Amazing Fantasy #15 — the title's final issue. He only got in because it was being cancelled.

days.name: Doctor Who
days.why_da: Sendt dagen efter mordet på Kennedy, så næsten ingen så den. BBC gentog afsnittet ugen efter.
days.why_en: Broadcast the day after Kennedy was shot, so almost nobody saw it. The BBC repeated the episode the following week.

days.name: Jaws
days.why_da: Den mekaniske haj virkede næsten aldrig, så Spielberg måtte antyde den i stedet. Det blev filmens held.
days.why_en: The mechanical shark hardly ever worked, so Spielberg had to imply it instead. That turned out to be the film's luck.

days.name: Star Wars
days.why_da: Den åbnede i 32 biografer. Fox havde ingen tro på den og havde solgt legetøjsrettighederne til Lucas selv.
days.why_en: It opened in 32 cinemas. Fox had no faith in it and had sold the merchandising rights to Lucas himself.

days.name: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
days.why_da: Først et radiospil, så en bog. Svaret er 42.
days.why_en: First a radio play, then a book. The answer is 42.

days.name: Donkey Kong
days.why_da: Nintendos redning. Tømreren hed Jumpman, indtil nogen omdøbte ham til Mario.
days.why_en: The game that saved Nintendo. The carpenter was called Jumpman until somebody renamed him Mario.

days.name: Blade Runner
days.why_da: Den floppede, og så blev den en af de mest indflydelsesrige film nogensinde. Der findes syv forskellige klipninger.
days.why_en: It flopped, and then became one of the most influential films ever made. There are seven different cuts.

days.name: Back to the Future
days.why_da: Eric Stoltz spillede Marty i fem uger, før han blev udskiftet med Michael J. Fox, og alt blev filmet forfra.
days.why_en: Eric Stoltz played Marty for five weeks before being replaced by Michael J. Fox and everything was shot again.

days.name: Super Mario Bros.
days.why_da: Samme dag som NES'en kom i handlen i USA. Spillet lå i æsken.
days.why_en: The same day the NES went on sale in America. The game was in the box.

days.name: Calvin & Hobbes
days.why_da: Watterson nægtede at sælge merchandise og stoppede efter ti år, mens striben var på toppen.
days.why_en: Watterson refused all merchandising and stopped after ten years, while the strip was at its peak.

days.name: The Simpsons
days.why_da: De havde været korte indslag i The Tracey Ullman Show siden 1987. Nu fik de deres egen halve time.
days.why_en: They had been shorts on The Tracey Ullman Show since 1987. Now they got their own half hour.

days.name: Superman dør
days.why_da: Superman #75. Hæftet var pakket i en sort plastikpose med en blodig kappe. Folk stod i kø.
days.why_en: Superman #75. The issue came sealed in a black polybag with a bloodied cape. People queued for it.

days.name: DOOM
days.why_da: Lagt på en ftp-server i Wisconsin, som brød sammen under presset. Inden for to år lå det på flere pc'er end Windows.
days.why_en: Uploaded to an ftp server in Wisconsin, which collapsed under the load. Within two years it was on more PCs than Windows.

days.name: Super Mario 64
days.why_da: Det første spil, der fandt ud af, hvordan et kamera skal opføre sig i tre dimensioner.
days.why_en: The first game to work out how a camera should behave in three dimensions.

days.name: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
days.why_da: Den amerikanske udgivelse. Den britiske, med Philosopher's Stone i titlen, kom året før i et oplag på 500.
days.why_en: The American edition. The British one, with Philosopher's Stone in the title, came the year before in a print run of 500.

days.name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
Firefly
days.why_da: Fox sendte afsnittene i forkert rækkefølge og aflyste serien efter fjorten. Den fik en film alligevel.
days.why_en: Fox aired the episodes out of order and cancelled the show after fourteen. It got a film anyway.

days.name: Portal
days.why_da: Det udkom som fyld i en samlepakke og blev det, alle huskede.
days.why_en: It shipped as filler in a bundle and became the thing everybody remembered.

days.name: Iron Man
days.why_da: Marvel pantsatte rettighederne til deres egne figurer for at få den finansieret.
days.why_en: Marvel mortgaged the rights to its own characters to get it financed.

days.name: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
